description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class EmployeeLicenseTest that tests the EmployeeLicense entity in the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, creates related Employee and License entities, associates them in an EmployeeLicense object, persists it, and verifies the correctness of entity relationships and field values.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class inheriting from EntityTestCase that validates the EmployeeLicense entity's creation, persistence, and data integrity within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating relevant tables before each test run.

methods.name: testEmployeeLicenseEntity
methods.description: Creates Employee and License objects, associates them via EmployeeLicense, persists them, and asserts that the retrieved data matches expectations.
